components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single cobalt action used for the highest-priority operation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 46px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--control-radius); color: #fff; background: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 9px 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 24%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.34); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; transition: background 180ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 75%, white); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Raised Card
components.description: A near-white panel with one shallow cool Neumorphic lift.
components.html: Số dư khả dụng42.680.000 ₫
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--panel-radius); color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-raised); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 570; } .ds-card-value { display: block; margin-top: 20px; font-size: clamp(31px, 9.6vw, 40px); font-weight: 710; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A clean solid field with a visible cobalt focus and explicit error state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 75%, transparent); border-radius: var(--control-radius); color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface-solid); font: inherit; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; caret-color: var(--accent); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 38%, transparent); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 75%, white); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--negative); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A recessed choice group with a cobalt selected segment.
components.css: .ds-segment { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--surface-inset); box-shadow: var(--shadow-inset); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-segment button { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; transition: color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-segment button:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-segment button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 75%, white); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-segment button:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-segment button.ds-is-active { color: #fff; background: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 5px 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: Mạch feels like a calm current: a pearl-grey field, shallow cool highlight-and-shadow pairs, graphite type, and rare cobalt action. Minimalism controls density; Neumorphism supplies material feedback only where touch and hierarchy benefit from it. The system favors immediate financial legibility, quiet rows, explicit states, and generous breathing room.
keyCharacteristics: Pearl-grey ground with near-white material surfaces.
One cobalt action family with restrained semantic color.
Shallow cool depth, never more than one raised layer.
Graphite Geist typography with tabular financial numerals.
Quiet divider-led rows and at least 44px mobile targets.

rules.name: The One Current Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks primary action, selection, active navigation, and focus; do not introduce a second brand accent.

rules.name: The Numerals Lead Rule
rules.body: Financial values use tabular numerals and tighter tracking; labels remain compact and visually subordinate.

rules.name: The Mobile Density Rule
rules.body: Mobile establishes the default touch size and reading order; larger screens add space, not smaller controls.

rules.name: The One-Layer Rule
rules.body: A raised surface may contain flat or inset children, never another raised panel.

rules.name: The Meaning Before Material Rule
rules.body: State must remain clear through text, color, or focus treatment when shadows are removed.

dos: Do keep the page ground pearl-grey and place primary content on near-white surfaces.
Do reserve cobalt for the primary action, active destination, selected segment, focus, and sparse emphasis.
Do use tabular numerals for balances, amounts, dates, and percentages.
Do keep mobile tap targets at least 44px and preserve the 320px no-horizontal-scroll floor.
Do pair positive, negative, and warning color with explicit copy or labels.
donts: Don't recreate detail-heavy Neumorphism, deep embossing, or more than one raised layer.
Don't use shadow alone to communicate selection, status, validation, or interactivity.
Don't add gradients or a competing brand accent to make the interface feel more premium.
Don't compress rows or controls to fit more finance data into the first view.
Don't promote page-specific charts, renewal geometry, or dashboard column arrangements into global component rules.
